specs.value: Tank, cover plate, base pad, starter guide
The tank sold together with filter and LED light

fits.fact: Made for aquascaping: the deep footprint and rounded corners leave room for hardscape and plants
Suits shrimp, snails and small fish such as chili rasboras or celestial pearl danios (galaxy rasboras)
Can hold a single feature fish such as a betta or dwarf gourami, or work as a guppy breeding tank
Small internal filters (for example sponge filters) and low-wattage heaters are recommended
Dennerle's 31 cm Scaper's Back background film fits the 34 cm-tall 55 L tank, and the substrate covers the 3 cm gap at the bottom

usage.fact: The foam safety pad under the tank comes already fitted
The glass evaporation lid needs its plastic corner holders attached before use
With an external filter, use the shorter cover plate so there is room for the hoses
You must buy the filter, light and heater separately

issues.fact: Buyer reviews are mostly positive: neat silicone seams, good packing and good value; no leaks reported
A minor complaint is that the cover glass only works once the small plastic corner pieces are fitted
Some retailers list the clear-glass Scaper's Tank as sold out; Dennerle now sells the 55 L size with the same dimensions as the Nano Tank, including a White Glass version
The standard version uses ordinary float glass; the White Glass version is clearer and costs more

alternatives.why: Premium ultra-clear rimless 45 cm tank (45 x 27 x 30 cm, about 36 L, 5 mm glass). It holds less water than the Dennerle and costs more, but it is the standard tank for aquascaping. No Vietnamese shop listing or VND price was found to confirm local stock.
Same 45 x 36 x 34 cm size made with clearer low-iron glass, from Dennerle's current range. No Vietnamese shop listing was found to confirm local stock.
Same tank sold with filter and LED light, so a beginner gets a complete setup. No Vietnamese shop listing was found to confirm local stock.
